name: saleseq
description: Give Codex your meetings. SalesEQ records, transcribes, and analyzes every call your team runs — search across transcripts by topic or speaker, pull summaries and full transcripts, recap what was said, and prep for the next call. The meeting context layer for Codex and any MCP-compatible agent.

interface.shortDescription: Your meetings, in the conversation. Search transcripts, recap calls, and prep for the next one.
interface.longDescription: SalesEQ records, transcribes, and analyzes the meetings your team runs, then makes them available to your agent as searchable context. Search across every transcript by topic, phrase, or speaker and get back the best-matching moments with playback offsets. Pull a generated summary when you need the gist, or a time-sliced transcript when you need exact wording. Resolve a teammate's name to their account before searching their calls, and pull a still frame from a moment on the recording. All six tools are read-only and scoped to what your account can already reach — meetings you own, meetings shared with you, and meetings shared with a group you belong to. Use cases: meeting recap and follow-up, pre-call prep, deal and pipeline review, QBR preparation, call coaching, surfacing commitments and action items, tracking objections across a deal, and answering 'who said what, and when'.
defaultPrompt: What did we commit to on my last call with Acme?
Summarize every customer call I had this week.
Find where pricing came up across my meetings this month.
